title: Use a module with use
objective: Bring a standard module into a program with use, then call one of its functions.

body.text: A module is a set of related functions that you bring in with use. Write use, then the module name, on a line near the top of the program. After that its functions are available by name, the same way as functions you wrote yourself.

body.title: Square root from the math module
body.code:
use math

say square root of 16
